_meta.artifact: doctor-check SPEC for the kali chassis toolset; planning artifact only - no tool was executed to build it
_meta.scan_scope: agentic_ai/agents/cyber/*.py modules defining a `class *Mixin` (the landed mixin planners)
_meta.scan_rule: tool tokens are measured from the modules' string-literal planning material at generation time; planner_modules per tool = the modules whose command strings invoke it
_meta.inclusion_rule: a tool enters the matrix when it is INVOKED inside a kali-side planning command string: a command segment head (split on newlines/;/pipes), a python3<tool>.py script invocation, or a documented embedded invocation (openssl). Aliases: myth -> mythril (the mythril catalog row invokes Mythril via its legacy 'myth' CLI).

excluded_classes.target-host syntax: postexp/privesc host-enum and arc command strings plus ad_pentest's nltest and container_pentest's in-container enum (cat/ls/mount) run on the compromised host, container, or device console - not the kali toolset; their binaries (whoami, netstat, reg, sc, schtasks, netsh, show, config, ...) are out of matrix
excluded_classes.transport-core: POSIX-obligatory pipe/compound conveniences invoked mid-pipeline (grep, head, sort, tee) plus interpreters used purely as script transport (python3) are not doctor entries; the script tools themselves (smuggler, xsstrike, graphql-cop) are
excluded_classes.template-less catalog ids: chain_ops analyzer ids with template=None are offered methodology rows without an invoked binary and stay out until their invocation lands
excluded_classes.named-not-invoked: tools referenced by name in activities/checklists without a command string
excluded_classes.data catalogs: tool names inside generated data catalogs consumed by mixin modules (data/xss_tools.json, redteam_pentest's gist-sourced tool catalog) follow the catalog contract and stay out of this module-string matrix

excluded_mentions.cdk: container escape toolkit named in the container_pentest tool checklist; no invoked command string in the tree
excluded_mentions.clairvoyance: named alongside inql as an introspection helper in an api_pentest activity string; never invoked
excluded_mentions.deepce: docker enumeration toolkit named in the container_pentest tool checklist; no invoked command string
excluded_mentions.dnsmasq: named in a wireless_pentest activity note (rogue-AP lab net); never invoked
excluded_mentions.frida: named in a mobile_pentest dynamic-lane note; no invoked command string
excluded_mentions.impacket: referenced inside postexp lateral-exec forbidden-class patterns (target-side arc syntax)
excluded_mentions.inql: named in an api_pentest activity string (graphql tooling context); never invoked
excluded_mentions.kube-bench: k8s CIS benchmark named in the container_pentest tool checklist; no invoked command string
excluded_mentions.kubehound: k8s graphing toolkit named in the container_pentest tool checklist; no invoked command string
excluded_mentions.manticore: chain_ops analyzer row id with template=None (no invoked binary in the tree)
excluded_mentions.medusa: chain_ops analyzer row id with template=None (no invoked binary in the tree)
excluded_mentions.move-analyzer: chain_ops analyzer row id with template=None (no invoked binary in the tree)
excluded_mentions.cargo-contract-audit: chain_ops analyzer row id with template=None (no invoked binary in the tree)
excluded_mentions.woke: chain_ops analyzer row id with template=None (no invoked binary in the tree)

_meta.out_of_scan_modules_note: the chassis (kali.py, kali_v2.py) and the plain modules are outside the landed-mixin scan scope by the task's enumeration rule; the chassis composes these mixins and inherits this toolset
_meta.minimum_versions_policy: no minimum version is documented anywhere in the fleet tree for these tools; every minimum_version is null with the per-tool note. INT-5+ owns the live doctor execution and may add documented floors later - in the same task that documents them.
_meta.where_checked_policy: where_checked values are the first-choice documented probes a doctor would run; INT-5+ validates flags live and falls back (-V/-v/--help/no-arg banner) where a tool has no version flag. None were executed here.
